title: Barbate
summary: B'ARBATE B'ARBATED, adjective [Latin barbatus, from barba. See Barb.] In botany, bearded; also gaping or ringent. Barbatus flos, a gaping or ringent flower; synonymous with the ringent flower of Linne

inlines.v: B'ARBATE B'ARBATED, adjective [Latin barbatus, from barba. See Barb.] In botany, bearded; also gaping or ringent. Barbatus flos, a gaping or ringent flower; synonymous with the ringent flower of Linne, and the labiate of Tournefort.
